# Alpha OS — EOD TOUCH10/60 calibration, continuous portfolio ledger and 15% drawdown economics (RESEARCH ONLY)

## Background and decisions
Follow [Issue #23](https://github.com/volk468-max/Analytical-Engine/issues/23) / [Draft PR #24](https://github.com/volk468-max/Analytical-Engine/pull/24), head as inspected on 2026-11-08 `51fb1d34ddb7a28e8bbc7b2361dcfc2107890f0b`, itself dependent on Draft PR #22, and original [Issue #21](https://github.com/volk468-max/Analytical-Engine/issues/21). Owner explicitly approved this next **research stage**, NOT any live trading or model deployment.

Three *hypothetical* AMD/NVDA/MU USD portfolios:
A = 1/3 each, cash 0;
B = 20% each, USD cash 40% (0% interest baseline);
C = inverse trailing 252-day volatility, capped 10–50% per ticker, cash 0.
Historical normalized inception NAV USD 100k; not user's actual holdings.

**Target:** EOD_CLOSE_TOUCH10_60: at least one of next 60 US-session closes of frozen no-trade portfolio <=90% of NAV at decision close. This is explicitly distinct from the earlier ANY-INTRADAY target. **Risk budget:** 15% peak-to-trough *continuous, flow-adjusted portfolio NAV* drawdown, target not guaranteed. Never equate portfolio recipes reset at each forecast anchor with a self-financing continuously held account.

Prior PR24 2010–2026 tests (4,178 overlapping anchors/recipe, effective N approx 90, ~34 120-session blocks) showed REGIME Brier A .248474/B .194041/C .246525 vs HIST A .252828/B .199413/C .251529; all 6 incremental comparisons CIs include zero, Holm p=.954, calibration bias +8–11 percentage points. No demonstrated predictive advantage; previously explored history not untouched. Preserve negative evidence.

## Phase 0 — protocol FIRST
Commit a predeclared `protocol-calibration-ledger.md` BEFORE inspecting/recomputing outcomes. Freeze: calibration methods/hyperparameters, temporal windows, label maturity and embargo, baselines, primary metrics, confidence intervals, correction for multiple comparisons, ledger rebalance policies, costs, GO/NO-GO and known data limitations. Separate descriptive historical analysis from independent prospective validation. No hyperparameter tuning to already-seen test outcomes.

## Phase 1 — price/action audit gate
- Reuse PR24 frozen Yahoo responses with verified raw hashes; do NOT silently refresh/revise sources.
- Independent reconciliation of split-normalized Close, dividends, splits and ex-date accounting using a second independent publicly available source for a preregistered set of material corporate actions (e.g. NVDA/AMD splits, MU/QQQ dividends). Verify no double adjustments and gross total-return continuity around event dates. Record exact URLs/retrieval times/licenses, discrepant rows and blocking qualifications. If unavailable, **BLOCKED**, not fabricated or certified PIT.
- Explicitly mark historical source `RESEARCH_PRICE_REPLAY_NOT_PIT`, selected survivor basket, and inability to verify original historical vintages. Do not claim daily close was tradable at same close after seeing it.

## Phase 2 — genuinely as-of calibration study (not post-hoc)
- Use PR24's annual expanding HIST, REGIME, VOL forecast protocols and matured EOD labels. Forecasts at t use only prices/features and **matured** labels published by t; no future60 labels or annual backfill. Model training, calibration fitting and evaluation MUST be chronologically nested/rolling, with explicit train/cal/test windows and >=60-session outcome maturity/embargo. No random CV, no global calibration fit on all 2010–2026 test outcomes.
- Primary calibrator: **intercept-only logistic recalibration** (predeclare window and regularization); secondary exploratory: logistic intercept+slope or monotone isotonic only if effective sample supports it. If low effective N, show unstable/blocked instead of overconfident calibration. Compare *raw* HIST, REGIME, VOL and recalibrated versions with a same-event, same-date rolling climatology baseline. Predeclare whether HIST is calibrated (do not change benchmark post hoc).
- Output Brier/log loss, calibration-in-the-large, slope (if identifiable), reliability diagram/table with **effective** bin support, expected calibration error as diagnostic only, base rates, decision-curve or threshold reliability only if credible, and paired date-block bootstrap CIs (L=60/120/180), adjusted multiple comparisons, block power/precision. Separate marginal bias reduction from actual ranking/forecast information; an intercept correction may improve Brier without predicting *when* losses happen. Do not claim success based on 4,178 dependent anchors; disclose ~34 blocks and reused history. No data snooping / no false 'independent holdout'.
- Report whether 35%, 51%, 60% thresholds occur and are calibrated, with support counts/CI. If unsupported, mark `NOT VALIDATED`; do not recommend trims.
- Do not add Fed/news/credit features or arbitrary probability points in this PR.

## Phase 3 — continuous self-financing portfolios for 15% DD
Implement an independent, unit-tested continuous daily NAV ledger (NOT a collection of anchor-reset labels):
- Three portfolios A/B/C with identical start date (after 252-day warmup) and common calendar; inception USD100k; track units, cash, split/dividend receivables, dividends, rebalance trades, fees, turnover, HWM, daily drawdown, exposure. Define fixed rebalancing policy in protocol: **monthly at next session open if reliable open corporate-action alignment can be qualified**, otherwise **monthly close with decision from previous close and execution at following close**, explicitly exposing execution lag and untradeable-lookahead caveat. If open-price alignment is unsupported, do NOT claim executable strategy. All weights C computed from historical observations known before trade; no future weights.
- Baselines: A equal-weight monthly rebalance, B 20/20/20/40 monthly rebalance, C constrained inverse-vol monthly rebalance; add static buy-and-hold A and B (no rebalance) if feasible. Cash baseline0% interest, optional preregistered T-bill yield sensitivity only with PIT-qualified rates. Dividend payment dates missing: use ex-date receivable with no interest, distinguish from spendable cash; prohibit spending receivables before payment if pay dates unknown.
- Costs: zero-cost research baseline plus fixed, preregistered sensitivity 10bps and 25bps per traded notional, plus explicitly assumed spreads; do not invent broker-specific tax/slippage. Disclose no short/leverage, fractional shares, cash-constrained fills and turnover.
- Report continuous maxDD, duration below HWM, count/duration of 15% breaches, worst 60-session loss, CAGR, annualized volatility, terminal NAV, turnover, fees, missed upside and cash drag, including subperiods and sensitivity. 15% risk budget is **not a hard stop or guarantee**. If no defensible execution/corporate action data, publish descriptive ledger and label NON-EXECUTABLE; no policy recommendation.
- IMPORTANT: A/B/C vary exposure; lower B drawdown is NOT alpha. Compare at common risk budget / exposure when attributing any added model value. Do NOT optimize A/B/C weights using evaluation history.

## Phase 4 — prospective shadow forecast log specification
- Implement **offline-only** append-only schema, with actual UTC decision timestamp, code/protocol/model/source hashes, portfolio recipe/snapshot, EOD label type, raw and calibrated P + uncertainty (nullable), data quality/staleness and later 60-session matured outcome in separate record. A local mock/test is allowed; NO scheduled live job, external database, hosted automation or deployment without separate owner approval.
- Define prospective minimum monitoring duration and power/precision plan; rare independent episodes may require years. Do not claim the past 2010–2026 is a fresh holdout.

## Quality gates and deliverables
- A *new dependent Draft PR* based on PR24 head, leave PR20/22/24 unmerged and unchanged; clearly state base SHA and dependencies. Small staged commits, protocol first.
- Russian executive summary, source/action audit, prereg protocol, source hashes, reproducible scripts, deterministic tests, forecasts/calibration reliability, ledger, economics, sensitivity, confidence intervals and explicit DONE/BLOCKED/NOT DONE and GO/NO-GO. Only show real metrics if qualified data support them; otherwise NA.
- CI status must be checked on actual head SHA; don't conflate test passing with predictive validity. No merge, production modifications, deploy, broker integration, trades, paid data or subscription.
- Existing **PR22 Tactical Ladder wrong direction/fixed anchor is a BLOCKING defect** for any trading-policy comparisons; do not call it, reuse it or silently patch it here. Fix separately in PR22 with tests.
- **No automatic 35/51/60% trim policy simulation in this PR** unless explicitly separately authorized after calibration and ledger review.

## Stop conditions
Stop and report blockers rather than generating fake calibration, false PIT-certified data, simulated actual brokerage P&L, or guarantee of <=15% DD. If the scope cannot be responsibly completed in one PR, deliver phase0 + phase1 + a minimal calibrated baseline first, mark the ledger as next milestone.
